Level 21 Plus Group Audit
=========================

Purpose
-------
Audit whether the terminal age is accumulating biomass or distorting the
longline tail age composition under age-based M and dome-shaped selectivity.

Interpretation
--------------
If n10 or plus_share grows large while longline age-10 predicted composition
is inconsistent with observations, the terminal age is likely distorting the
tail. If n10 remains modest but ages 8-9 dominate selected numbers, the issue
is more likely longline dome-shaped selectivity or catch-at-age vs selected-
numbers age-composition basis.
